intro: On October 8, 2026 the QuantAura four-model ensemble published a SELL call on Bitcoin at 92.4 percent confidence.
Bitcoin was trading at $81,920 when the call was made.
days: Twenty-four hours later the price had moved +0.86 percent, so the call was graded incorrect.
A SELL call needs price to move more than 1 percent in its direction within 24 hours to be graded correct.
trend: Going into the day, the public record stood at 27 hits and 37 misses over 64 graded calls, an accuracy of 42.2 percent.
